test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Manisha Kalyan is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Kalyan** is an **Indian professional footballer** renowned for her role as a forward.
 
• She currently represents the Cypriot First Division club Apollon and competes for the India women's national team.
 
• Kalyan's exceptional talent has earned her prestigious accolades, including the 2020–21 AIFF Women's Emerging Footballer of the Year and the 2022–23 AIFF Women's Player of the Year awards.
 
• She holds the distinction of being the first Indian footballer to participate in the UEFA Women's Champions League.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In 2018, Kalyan embarked on her professional journey by signing with the newly established Indian Women's League club, Gokulam Kerala.
 
• Her remarkable skills and dedication to the sport led her to sign a contract with the Limassol-based Cypriot First Division club, Apollon Ladies, on July 3, 2022.
 
• Kalyan made her debut for the national team in January 2019, showcasing her prowess against Indonesia.
 
• She marked her presence with a memorable goal against Bangladesh during the 2019 SAFF Women's Championship.
